description: Day-ahead electricity spot prices from Energi Data Service (Energinet, Denmark/Nordic). Prices per bidding zone (PriceArea) in DKK and EUR per MWh, hourly. Bidding zones: DK1 (west Denmark), DK2 (east Denmark), DE (Germany), NO2, SE3, SE4, and others. Omit "area" to get all zones. Keyless official open data.

area.description: Bidding zone, e.g. "DK1", "DK2", "DE". Omit for all areas.

limit.description: Max records (default 24, i.e. last 24 hourly rows).

start.description: ISO date/time lower bound, e.g. "2026-06-01" or "2026-06-01T00:00".

name: spot_prices
title: Spot Prices
